mapper.sql: SELECT u.id,u.username,u.display_name,u.password_hash,u.enabled,u.auth_version, (SELECT string_agg(r.code,',' ORDER BY r.code) FROM user_role ur JOIN app_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.id) AS role_codes, (SELECT sa.shop_id FROM shop_account sa WHERE sa.user_id=u.id) AS shop_id FROM app_user u
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM app_user WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_role(user_id,role_id) SELECT #{id},id FROM app_role WHERE code=#{role}
INSERT INTO owner_profile(user_id,display_name) VALUES (#{id},#{displayName}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING
